recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. Reintroducing a direct Provenance.entity URI choice would reverse later published Reference/Provenance modeling decisions; any future distinct URI requirement should be handled as a new Security/MnM issue.
issue_request: FHIR-12480 was a Published Security work group change request raised against DSTU2 and resolved Persuasive with Modification. It asked to change Provenance.entity.reference into entity.what[x] so the entity could be identified by either a URI or Reference(Any), because Provenance sometimes needs to point at non-FHIR source material.
initial_application: Git commit 8058a0886c12cc7a61a61db3edae51be5e5698ef explicitly cited GF#12480 and changed the old Provenance.entity.reference spreadsheet model to Provenance.entity.what[x] with uri|Reference(Any)|Identifier choices, plus matching search path updates.
additional_context: FHIR-13694 clarified Reference.identifier logical-reference semantics, FHIR-13570 removed Provenance.entity.whatUri as redundant, FHIR-15659 simplified Provenance.entity.what[x] to a single Reference after logical references made separate choices redundant, and FHIR-49893 corrected the current comment to what.identifier. Related Provenance entity issues FHIR-12503 and FHIR-15659 are already represented on the combined branch.
reconciliation: No source change was made. Active current Provenance source defines Provenance.entity.what as Reference(Resource) and tells readers to use what.identifier for entities that are not a Resource type; the Reference datatype defines Reference.identifier as the logical-reference mechanism, including Reference(Any) cases where no FHIR representation exists.

related_jiras.note: Same Provenance entity non-FHIR content support family; already audited on the combined branch.
Same implementation commit added Identifier support for non-FHIR source material.
Clarified Reference.identifier logical-reference semantics used by the current Provenance model.
Removed Provenance.entity.whatUri as redundant and tied Provenance guidance to Reference.identifier.
Removed redundant Provenance whatIdentifier/whatReference choices after logical references were introduced.
Corrected the current Provenance.entity.what comment from whatIdentity to what.identifier.
